اهتلكوا (form VIII)
# اِهْتَلَكُوا (ihtalakū) /ih.ta.la.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اُهْتُلِكُوا (uhtulikū) /uh.tu.li.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# اِهْتَلِكُوا (ihtalikū) /ih.ta.li.kuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
